title: group_create — output
description: Output schema for the SOX group_create operation. Returns the full group channel name (with 'group/' prefix) and the creation timestamp. Normative reference: spec/primitives/groups.md §5.1.

group_id.description: The full group channel name including the 'group/' prefix (e.g. 'group/eng-team').

created_at.description: Unix epoch seconds when the group was created.
